name: Ignatius: Second Epistle to St John
title: Ignatius: Second Epistle to St John

chapters.title: His friend Ignatius to John the holy presbyter

verses.text:
If thou wilt give me leave, I
desire to go up to Jerusalem, and see the faithful Some omit this word.

Literally, “of
herself.” Some read, instead of “de se,”
“deorum,” when the translation will be, “the
true God of gods.”
